text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing all of today's training, 
while walking with Aston Machan—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Turbo is working so hard. It kind of 
inspires me. I think I'll record her 
running.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, the Chan-radar is reacting. If only 
someone could capture Chan doing her best 
like that too...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: That'll lead to overwork, so let's not.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're running too, Chan-Ma? Then 
let's race, let's have a match!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
! ...Fufufu, that is just what I've been 
waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Once the race begins, you'll leave an 
even stronger impression."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Feel free to take photos over there as 
well. Go ahead and post them all over 
social media too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Aston Machan showed her grit, 
Twin Turbo fired up even more, and the two 
pushed each other to their absolute 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm... But it's true, it would look 
pretty uncool if I got exhausted right 
away from training fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is a patient girl. Mar-chan 
shall quietly take her leave here."
